title: Schedule 1 to the Corporate Catering Service Agreement: Order Values and Guest Counts
content:
## Schedule 1 — order values and guest counts

This schedule forms part of the Corporate Catering Service Agreement and is read against the service level written on the client's agreement. Four figures are printed against each service level: the smallest order value the service level accepts, the smallest guest count it is written for, the largest guest count it handles, and the number of unserved orders the agreement may carry at once.

| Service level | Smallest order value accepted | Smallest guest count | Largest guest count | Unserved orders carried at once |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Drop-Off Catering Account | 85.00 USD | 6 | 40 | 5 |
| Delivered Buffet Account | 225.00 USD | 12 | 120 | 10 |
| Attended Buffet Account | 480.00 USD | 20 | 250 | 20 |
| Staffed Full-Service Catering Account | 1250.00 USD | 25 | 450 | 35 |
| Executive Hospitality Catering Account | 2400.00 USD | 8 | 60 | 25 |
| Campus Catering Master Account | 3500.00 USD | 40 | 900 | 60 |

### Reading the columns

The smallest order value accepted is the smallest order value the service level takes, in USD. The smallest guest count is the smallest guest count the service level is written for, as a whole number, and the largest guest count is the largest the service level handles without a separate event agreement. The last column is the number of unserved orders the agreement may carry at once.

### Points of judgement

The guest band is not monotonic across the schedule. The Executive Hospitality Catering Account serves a small room at a high order value — 8 guests at the low end and 60 at the high end, on orders of at least 2400.00 USD — while the Attended Buffet Account, at a quarter of that entry value, is written up to 250 guests. Where a client asks which service level a party of 50 sits on, the answer therefore depends on the order value as much as on the head count.

By way of illustration, a hypothetical order for 30 guests at 900.00 USD meets the smallest order value and sits inside the guest band of the Attended Buffet Account; the same order on a Drop-Off Catering Account exceeds that level's largest guest count of 40 only if the party grows past 40.
